system.description:
To cast this incantation, you must focus on a nearby corpse. As you make whispered inquiries, the corpse will answer in its native tongue. A corpse without an intact mouth cannot speak its reply, but may still be able to answer your questions by tapping the floor or raising fingers to signal yes or no. Allegiance as well as grudges may persist beyond the grave, and the subject may regard you cautiously or require coaxing to share its most intimate knowledge.

With no sparks, you are limited to two questions. Each spark grants you two more.
